parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
State the formula for the de Broglie wavelength $\lambda$ of a moving particle.
State the meaning of any other symbols you use.

markscheme_points.text: h h = or = p mv λ λ
where h is the Planck constant and p is the momentum (of particle) / mv is the momentum (of particle) / m is the mass (of particle) and v is the velocity (of particle)

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The accelerating potential difference is changed and a new pattern is seen on the screen.
The new pattern has rings of smaller diameter than the original pattern.
State and explain whether the accelerating potential difference was increased or decreased.

markscheme_points.text: Any one of: • wavelength has decreased • electron had greater momentum

hints: Hint 1: Focus on the physical mechanism in A Level Physics theory and principles that causes this behavior.
Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.
parts.proper_answer: Any one of: • wavelength has decreased • electron had greater momentum; so (accelerating) p.d. was increased
